title: Nonprofit Current AI is racing to build the World Wide Web of AI, free for all
slides: What if AI were as free as the web itself?
Current AI builds an open, nonprofit stack.
Most AI progress is locked behind corporate walls.
You can access and extend every model they release.
Try their playground today—no payment needed.
thread_text:
1. What if AI were free?

Hugging Face already hosts over 500,000 open models anyone can download and run.

2. The stack is open.

Nonprofits like EleutherAI and BigScience publish every layer—data, training code, weights—for free.

3. Behind corporate walls.

OpenAI and Google keep their most capable models secret. The real race hides inside private servers.

4. You can extend them.

Download a model, fine-tune it on your own data, and deploy it without asking permission from anyone.

5. Try the playground today.

Go to Hugging Face Chat and run a model right now. No signup. No credit card. What will you build?

instagram.caption:
Hundreds of thousands of open AI models are already free to download and adapt—no corporate gatekeeping required.

A nonprofit stack gave away the training code, data, and weights. No walls, no "access denied". Models are yours to fine-tune and deploy.

That changes how you build: grab a model, train it on your own files, ship it without asking permission 🔓.

What will you release into this open web? Try Hugging Face Chat now—zero signup 🧪
